_comment: Ambitions, Paradox style: the captain chases one at a time (scripts/ambitions.gd). Progress is a 'value' of your situation (any number the event conditions know: gold, fear, honour, prizes, bases...) or a 'tally' of deeds since you took it up (ships_taken, treasure_taken, lawful_prizes, rescues, finds, rivals_beaten, pardons, trade_profit, towns_taken). 'requires': event conditions for it to be offered. On success: 'rewards' (event outcomes), the 'title' for life, and any lasting 'bonus' (enemy_morale: added to every enemy's morale when you fight).

scourge.name: Scourge of the Main
scourge.description: Five prizes, and every master between Havana and Cartagena will know your topsails.
scourge.title: Scourge of the Main

plate_fleet.name: The plate fleet
plate_fleet.description: Every year a galleon carries the silver of the Main to Havana. Every pirate dreams of one. Few live to try twice.
plate_fleet.title: the Galleon-Taker

corsair.name: Corsair of the Crown
corsair.goal: Take three lawful prizes under your letter of marque
corsair.description: Serve your sovereign well and the Admiralty remembers.
corsair.title: Corsair of the Crown

squadron.name: A squadron of my own
squadron.goal: Sail with two ships in company
squadron.description: One ship is a captain. Three is a commodore.
squadron.title: Commodore

fortune.name: A fortune
fortune.description: Enough to buy a plantation, a seat on a council, or a very great deal of rum.
fortune.title: the Rich

merchant.name: Merchant adventurer
merchant.description: Buy cheap, sell dear, and know before anyone else where dear is.
merchant.title: Merchant Adventurer

terror.name: A name to frighten children
terror.description: They'll strike at the sight of your colours. Or fight like rats in a corner.
terror.title: the Terror

gentleman.name: A gentleman of fortune
gentleman.description: Keep your word, spare your prisoners, and let them say what they like about pirates.
gentleman.title: the Gentleman

haven.name: A haven
haven.goal: Make a hidden cove your base
haven.description: Somewhere to careen, store plunder, and sleep without one eye open.
haven.title: Lord of the Cays

lifesaver.name: Friend to sailors
lifesaver.goal: Save two ships from their attackers
lifesaver.description: Come up on a fight at sea and take the weaker side.
lifesaver.title: the Sea's Friend

eagle_eye.name: Eyes of a hawk
eagle_eye.description: Wrecks, castaways, dispatches, turtles: the sea gives to those who look.
eagle_eye.title: Eagle-Eye

nemesis.name: Settle the score
nemesis.description: There's a captain out there who's wronged you. Find them.
nemesis.title: the Unbowed

pardon.name: A clean slate
pardon.description: Every governor sells forgiveness, for a price. Pay it and start again.
pardon.title: the Reformed

conqueror.name: Taker of Towns
conqueror.description: Ships are prizes; towns are kingdoms. Storm them, starve them or buy their gates, and every governor on the Main will sleep badly.
conqueror.title: the Town-Taker
